records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 11% to $150.3 million during the three months ended March 31, 2024 from $135.4 million during the three months ended March 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 67% of our revenue during the three months ended March 31, 2024, as compared to 65% in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: Software license revenue represented 2% of our revenue during the three months ended March 31, 2024, as compared to 3% in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: While the additional import duties resulted in an increase to our cost of hardware revenue, these import duties had a modest impact on hardware revenue margins.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2024, cash flows from operating activities were $49.9 million, compared to cash flows used in operating activities of $3.5 million for the same period in the prior year.
